name: GPU-based Voxelization of 3D Minkowski Sum
definition: A method to compute the voxelized Minkowski sum of two arbitrary polyhedra A and B directly on the GPU, generating both solid and surface voxelizations without computing a complete boundary representation (B-rep).
summary: GPU-based Voxelization of 3D Minkowski Sum computes solid and surface voxelizations of two polyhedra directly on the GPU, bypassing complex boundary representations by leveraging rasterization and depth testing.
